snippet.title: Grandpa's Bee Haven Trailer
snippet.description:
A cozy 2D idle beekeeping sim that sits at the bottom of your screen. Help Grandpa build his bee haven by setting up beehives, upgrading them, unlocking new hive types, bee species, beekeeping equipment and more land. 

Wishlist the game in Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209160/Grandpas_Bee_Haven/
